method: Blind: labelled before pipeline/model-wrappers.ts was run on any of these repositories. An independent grep (model-shaped quoted strings in non-test files that import @ai-sdk/*, ai, @langchain/*, langchain or llamaindex) listed candidates; each candidate and the wrapper calls around it were read by hand, by one labeller, in one pass. A site is a model ID written in the repository that a wrapper call sends: the line of the string, its provider and the wrapper. Strings that reach a wrapper only through a request, user settings or a model table are not sites; `dynamic` describes them. Files matching the scanner's TEST_PATH (tests, examples, fixtures, stories) are left out on both sides. Labelled: the first 15 AI SDK OpenAI repositories by stars, the 5 AI SDK Anthropic repositories not already in that list, all 10 LlamaIndex repositories, and 10 of the 20 LangChain repositories, picked by hand among the smaller ones for time (presentation-ai, social-media-agent, devildev and chat-ollama were not labelled), which may favour simpler code there.
